annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulation binds owners (including operators) of automated commercial motor vehicles, their drivers, and persons who drive or permit operation of such vehicles on a highway; the Registrar is given powers.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No person shall drive or permit the operation of an automated commercial motor vehicle on a highway, except as permitted by this Regulation.
annotation.dates_quote: Except as otherwise provided in this section, this Regulation comes into force on the later of August 1, 2025 and the day this Regulation is filed.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: A pilot project to evaluate the use of automated commercial motor vehicles on highways is established.
